messages:
olivia: quick sync  im assembling a concise battlecard + webinar landing copy focused on competitive claims vs cloud AI platforms, public LLM APIs, and infra vendors. need: 2-greenhouse hero claims, 4x 10s rebut snippets, and exact inbound routing rules for SDRs.

sam.t: agree. hero claims i'd defend: 1) stable p99 latency under noisy multi-tenant load; 2) lower effective token spend thanks to batching + prefix/KV caching and recommended quantization profiles.

kevin: i'll add a small bench table showing 2k vs 6k seqs and an example $/1M token calc. call out model-family variance.

olivia: great. we also need a playbook snippet SDRs can copy/paste post-webinar (short).

nisha: drafts for SDR copy (short):
- vs managed cloud: "Great for POCs. For production we tune runtime controls (caching, batching, fallbacks) to stabilize cost & latency."
- vs LLM APIs: "APIs are quick to start, but don't give deployment options or per-token levers when you scale."
- vs infra vendors: "Buying GPUs is step one; we ship the runtime, rollouts, and tracing to run reliably."
- tech follow-up: "Want a 48hr bench vs your stack? We'll show latency and cost tradeoffs."

ravi: inbound routing rules: add webinar form fields and automatic tags. propose: form fields: company, company-size, primary use-case, deployment interest [Hosted/Dedicated/Private], compliance needs [HIPAA/SOC2], bench-focus [Latency/Cost/Compliance/Full]. rules (pseudo):
```
if deployment interest == Dedicated -> tag: Dedicated_interest, route to AM + SolutionsEng
if deployment interest == Private -> tag: Private_VPC, route to Enterprise-SE + Security
if bench-focus == Cost -> tag: Bench_Cost, route to Growth SDR + PM
if compliance needs checked -> tag: Compliance_lead, route to Security + AE
if company-size > 500 -> priority_flag = true -> AE alert
```

kevin: can we also add a quick objection-response for "cloud is simpler for global infra"? maybe: "Global infra is helpful; our smart routing + model fallbacks keep SLAs while lowering unit cost."

olivia: yes include that. also add a 1-paragraph blog hook that ties the webinar benches to an anonymized customer vignette (focus on cost reduction + fewer production incidents). someone volunteer a 200-250 word draft?

sam.t: i'll draft the blog hook. will weave in the bench figures and the routing CTA. aim to share Thurs EOD.

nisha: timeline: kevin uploads bench figures by Tue, ravi posts the form + zap routing Wed morning, sam shares blog draft Thu, olivia finalizes battlecard Fri. ops-bot: reminder about webinar slot.

ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved for 2026-05-12 11:00 PDT. Recording and slides will be posted to #events after session.

kevin: :thumbsup: added bench placeholders in drive (link in thread).

ravi: :thumbsup: will draft the automation PR and share the zaps.

sam.t: :thumbsup: starting blog draft tonight.

olivia: thanks team  i'll collate and push the battlecard PR when assets land. :rocket:
